card.secureNote: Yasungwa na Lenco — PCI compliant hosted checkout

card.widgetUnavailable: Card payments tashaisa nomba. Wesheni mobile money nangu limbi.

guide.deliveryHelp: Rider akamuletela ku Lusaka. Mukamona umutengo wa delivery ilyo tamulatuma order.

guide.groupHint: Seller onse alongela no kutuma ifintu fyakwe, e ico musalapo delivery nangu pickup kuli seller onse.
guide.tip1: Lumbuleni icifulo abantu bonse balishiba — church, isukulu, filling station nangu musika.
guide.tip2: Lembeni area ne street, ne cimo icingalanga geti lyenu, nga ni colour yalyo.
guide.tip3: Shalikeni foni yenu ili on. Rider kuti amutumina pa namba yenu pa kumusanga.
guide.landmarkRequired: Lembeni landmark ne area pa kuti rider amusange.
guide.cutoffBefore: Nga mwatuma order pa ntanshi ya 14:00 (inshita ya Lusaka), ifintu ifili mu stock kuti fyatumwa lelo, seller nga asuminisha.
guide.cutoffAfter: Ninshita ya pa numa ya 14:00 mu Lusaka, e ico ifili mu stock kuti fyatumwa mailo, seller nga asuminisha.
guide.cutoffMadeToOrder: Ifintu ifipangwa pa order fitumwa ilyo fyapwa — moneni inshita ya cila cintu.

payment.codIneligible: Cash on delivery yaisa fye ku ama-order mpaka {cap}.
payment.codRejected: Cash on delivery teyaisa ku total iyi ya order
payment.error: Tatwaishibe ukusunga payment method. Wesheni limbi.
payment.paymentsDisabled: Payment ya online teyaisa nomba. Longeni Cash on Delivery ilyo yaisa, nangu wesheni limbi.

payment.cardHelp: Lipileni pa page ya Lenco iyasungwa. Convergeo taibona ifya card yenu.
payment.codHelp: Lipileni cash ku courier ilyo order yafika ku ama-order ayasuminishwa.
